title: A Mars Trip Could Cost Astronauts 30% Of Hip Bone Density
hook: Weightlessness does not rest bones; a Mars trip could cost 30%.
closing: Floating feels effortless while the skeleton quietly pays for it.
question: Would 30% change your Mars plans?

segments.say: Astronaut bone density falls 1.5% monthly, exceeding Earth's 1% yearly osteoporosis loss.
Astronaut hips lose 2.2% monthly versus just 0.1% in the forearm.
An unprotected 30-month Mars mission could cost 30% hip density versus 9% in 6 months.
